observations: Three photos show a white PlayStation 5 console with two controllers in front: one black and one white/cream.
The console has a glossy finish with a black horizontal line separating the top and bottom halves.
The controllers have the standard DualSense design with analog sticks, D-pad, and four-way button layout.
The background includes a marble-patterned wall and a person's arm and leg in khaki pants.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'GEMINI GADGETS' are visible on all photos.
No visible damage to the console or controllers in the photos.
No games, cables, or accessories are shown in any photo.

claims.evidence: The console appears clean in photos, but 'UK used' cannot be verified remotely. No UK label or region-specific markings are visible.
Two controllers are shown, but no proof of originality (e.g., serial numbers, packaging, or authenticity tags) is visible. The black controller may be original, but the white one is not confirmed.
No games or game cases are visible in any photo. The FC26 package cannot be confirmed without seeing the games or their packaging.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have hardware issues
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-original or counterfeit
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the controllers showing serial numbers, authenticity tags, or packaging.

risks.risk: Games may not be included or may be pirated
risks.proof: Photos of the game cases or digital codes, or a video showing the games installed and playable.

risks.risk: Console may be region-locked or not compatible with Nigerian power supply
risks.proof: Photo of the console's power adapter and region label, or a video showing it powering on with the correct adapter.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and running a game.
Close-up photos of the controllers showing serial numbers and authenticity tags.
Photos of the 10 games or digital codes for the FC26 package.
Photo of the console's power adapter and region label.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
